Street address of the British Library in London — Answered.
The British Library's London site, at St Pancras, is at 96 Euston Road, London NW1 2DB. The library's own website gives this address, and its page footer carries a 2026 copyright line with the same address. [1] [2] [3]

Sources
[1] Visit the British Library — https://www.bl.uk/visit (search result age: 163 days ago)
[2] Contact us for help - British Library — https://www.bl.uk/about/contact
[3] British Library — https://www.visitlondon.com/things-to-do/place/283871-the-british-library
